encounters.mod.name: Encounters
yacl3.config.encounters:config.mobsDropE: When enabled, mobs spawned by any encounter event can drop the weapons and armor they spawned with. When disabled (default), their equipment is always kept.
yacl3.config.encounters:config.lightning: Master toggle for the lightning overcharge event. When disabled, natural thunderstorm lightning behaves normally.
Probability that any given natural thunderstorm lightning bolt triggers the event. 0 = never, 1 = every bolt.
Minimum number of mobs spawned when the event triggers.
Maximum number of mobs spawned when the event triggers.
When enabled, the first mob of a spawned group acts as leader. The others regroup around it whenever they stray too far, so the encounter stays together. Followers already in combat are left alone.
Distance in blocks beyond which a follower is pulled back toward its leader.
yacl3.config.encounters:config.netherPor: Enabled
Master toggle for the nether portal invasion event. When disabled, no portal will ever trigger an invasion.
Scan Interval (ticks)
How often the mod scans loaded chunks looking for active nether portals. 100 ticks = 5 seconds. Lower values are more reactive but slightly more expensive.
Max Concurrent Invasions
Maximum number of nether portal invasions that may run simultaneously across the level. Once reached, the scanner skips new triggers until one ends.
Min Distance Between Invasions
Minimum distance in blocks between two concurrent portal invasions. Prevents clusters when nearby portals would otherwise trigger together.
Post-Invasion Cooldown (ticks)
Minimum delay after any invasion ends before another one may trigger across the level. 12000 ticks = 10 minutes.
Trigger Chance
Probability that any eligible portal triggers an invasion on a given scan. 0 = never, 1 = every scan.
Waves (min)
Minimum number of waves per invasion.
Waves (max)
Maximum number of waves per invasion.
First Wave Size
Number of mobs in the first wave.
Wave Size Step
Linear scaling: each wave has 'first wave size + (wave-1) * step' mobs.
Wave Cohesion

When enabled, the first mob of each wave acts as leader. Other wave members regroup around it whenever they stray too far. Followers in active combat are left alone, and mounted passengers are skipped.
Cohesion Radius
Distance in blocks beyond which a wave member is pulled back toward its leader.
Magma Bomb Barrage

When enabled and Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks is loaded, the portal periodically lobs Magma Bomb spells out of the gateway during the invasion. The bombs follow a ballistic arc and explode on impact, leaving a fire field. Spell level scales +1 per wave (capped at 8). No effect when the mod is absent.
yacl3.config.encounters:config.patrolSki: Enabled
Master toggle for the patrol skirmish event. When disabled, no skirmish will ever spawn.
Scan Interval (ticks)
How often the scanner attempts to spawn a new patrol skirmish. 1200 ticks = 1 minute. Lower values are more reactive but slightly more expensive.
Trigger Chance
Probability that the scanner spawns a skirmish at an eligible site on a given scan. 0 = never, 1 = every scan.
Max Concurrent Skirmishes
Maximum number of skirmishes that may run simultaneously across the level. Once reached, the scanner skips new spawns until one ends.
Min Distance Between Skirmishes
Minimum distance in blocks between two concurrent skirmishes. Prevents clusters when multiple players roam different areas.
Cooldown (ticks)
Cooldown after any skirmish ends before a new one can spawn anywhere. 6000 ticks = 5 minutes.
Day Only
When enabled, skirmishes only spawn during daytime. Disabling allows night-time skirmishes — expect more chaos as vanilla hostile mobs may join in.
Skirmish Timeout (ticks)
Maximum lifetime of a skirmish before forced cleanup. 24000 ticks = 20 minutes.
Reward Wait Timeout (ticks)
After the combat ends, how long the reward cinematic waits for an eligible (non-hostile) player before giving up. 2400 ticks = 2 minutes.
Mobs Per Side
Number of mobs spawned per faction at skirmish start. Skirmish-scale (4-6) reads better than full-scale battles.
Caravan Chance Per Side
Probability that a caravan (a carrier leading a chest-bearing pack animal) accompanies each faction. Rolled independently per side.
